title: 2018 AMC 10B Problem 1
statement: Kate bakes a \(20\)-inch by \(18\)-inch pan of cornbread. The cornbread is cut into pieces that measure \(2\) inches by \(2\) inches. How many pieces of cornbread does the pan contain?

solutions.text: The whole pan has area \(20 \times 18 = 360\) square inches. Each piece is \(2 \times 2 = 4\) square inches. So the number of pieces is \(\frac{360}{4} = 90.\) Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: The pan and each piece are rectangles; compare their areas
Divide the total area by the area of one \(2 \times 2\) piece
